charts.title: Micron: AI-memory leader gives back gains
charts.significance: Micron closed at $878.78 on Oct 16, down 5.6% and 28% below its June 25 high; I read that as a valuation reset, not proof of weaker demand.
charts.label: MU · Price

charts.title: 10-year Treasury yield stays near 5.1%
charts.significance: The 10-year yield was 5.10% on Oct 15, down from 5.31% on Oct 5 but near its three-year high; high long-term rates can pressure high-growth AI stocks.
charts.label: 10Y Treasury Yield

charts.title: BBB corporate bond spreads near series lows
charts.significance: BBB corporate bond spreads were 1.05% on Oct 15, near the 0.92% series low, so credit does not yet confirm a broad AI-memory or financing crisis.
charts.label: BBB OAS

charts.title: Strategy shares drop 9.6% as Bitcoin sits near $81,300
charts.significance: Strategy fell 9.6% to $136.76 on Oct 16 while Bitcoin traded near $81,300; I read the drop as Bitcoin-treasury risk, but the supplied evidence does not establish the cause.

charts.title: Humana gives back Medicare star-rating rally
charts.significance: Humana closed at $413.06 on Oct 16, down 4.4% on the day, after a rally tied to higher 2027 Medicare quality scores; the stock still faces benefit cuts and enrollment risk.
